name: onetake-ci
description: Node test/export dependencies for CI only (.github/workflows/ci.yml). Lives in ci/ so the static site root has no package.json (Cloudflare Pages would otherwise npm-install on every deploy). Versions = the import map in index.html. playwright: the CI browser job (tests/browser.mjs; Chromium via npx playwright install chromium). node-web-audio-api: tests/seoul-audio.mjs (the CI audio job; prebuilt binaries, links libasound).
